; Carnets liés — v2
;  - bouton flottant "↔ <carnet lié>" dans les documents qui ont un lien
;  - liens lus dans /home/root/carnets-lies.json : {"links": {"<uuid>": {"to": "<uuid>", "name": "<nom>"}}}
;  - signaux via /run/xovi-mb :
;      ucarnetsOpen:<uuid>,<page>   ouvre un document (page à partir de 0, -1 = dernière page lue)
;      ucarnetsReload:              relit le fichier des liens
AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0
    TRAVERSE Background
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            XoviMessageBroker {
                id: carnetsBroker
                listeningFor: ["carnetsOpen", "carnetsReload"]
                function onSignalReceived(sgn, message) {
                    if (sgn === "carnetsReload") {
                        carnetsLies.reload();
                        return;
                    }
                    const parts = String(message).trim().split(",");
                    const p = parts.length > 1 ? parseInt(parts[1]) : -1;
                    console.log("[carnets] ouverture", parts[0], p);
                    root.onOpened({ documentId: parts[0], page: isNaN(p) ? -1 : p });
                }
            }

            Item {
                id: carnetsLies
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 1000
                property var links: ({})
                readonly property var currentDoc: (documentView.item && documentView.item.documentLoaded) ? documentView.item.document : null
                readonly property var link: currentDoc ? links[currentDoc.id] : undefined

                function reload() {
                    const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                    xhr.open("GET", "file:///home/root/carnets-lies.json", false);
                    try {
                        xhr.send();
                        links = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText).links || {};
                        console.log("[carnets] liens chargés :", Object.keys(links).length);
                    } catch (e) {
                        console.log("[carnets] lecture des liens impossible :", e);
                        links = {};
                    }
                }
                Component.onCompleted: reload()

                Rectangle {
                    id: carnetsButton
                    visible: !!carnetsLies.link
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                    anchors.rightMargin: 28
                    anchors.bottomMargin: 28
                    width: Math.min(carnetsLabel.implicitWidth + 56, 520)
                    height: 76
                    radius: 38
                    color: carnetsMouse.pressed ? "black" : "white"
                    border.color: "black"
                    border.width: 3

                    Text {
                        id: carnetsLabel
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        width: Math.min(implicitWidth, 464)
                        elide: Text.ElideRight
                        text: "↔  " + (carnetsLies.link ? carnetsLies.link.name : "")
                        font.pixelSize: 30
                        color: carnetsMouse.pressed ? "white" : "black"
                    }
                    MouseArea {
                        id: carnetsMouse
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        onClicked: {
                            const target = carnetsLies.link.to;
                            console.log("[carnets] bascule vers", target);
                            root.onOpened({ documentId: target });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
